verdict.rationale: The build-skills docs define the format directly: a skill is a directory with a SKILL.md that must include `name` and `description`, discovered from `.agents/skills`. A built-in skill creator interactively asks what the skill does, when it should trigger, and whether to include scripts. A community user reports building their own skills with skill-creator, and a hands-on probe installed a real SKILL.md with valid `name` frontmatter. Missing for 10: a verbatim copy-paste SKILL.md template (full frontmatter block and body example) quoted in the evidence.
